senses.gloss:
औदुंबर a. (री f.) [उदंबर-अञ्]
Made of, or coming from, the
Udumbara tree
--रः
1 N. of a region
abounding in Udumbara trees.
--2
A form of Yama, the god of death.
--री A branch of the Udumbara
tree.
--रं
1 The wood of the
Udumbara tree.
--2 The Udumbara
fruit.
--3 A kind of leprosy.
--4
Copper.

औदुंबरकः A place full of
Udumbara trees.
